courses.title: Builder Gel Overlay and Short Extension CPD Course
courses.accredited_title: Builder Gel Overlay and Short Extension CPD Course
courses.short: Add builder gel overlays and short extensions to your services: a one-day classroom course with online pre-course study, assessed by theory paper, observed practical and three case studies.
courses.delivery: Classroom course at The Looking Glass Beauty School, Shrewsbury, with the pre-course study, manual and support videos here.
courses.hours_breakdown: 2.5 hours pre-course study here, 7.5 guided learning hours on the taught day, about 7.5 hours for three case studies.
courses.prerequisites: Aged 18 or over, with a Level 2 Beauty Therapy, Nail Services or equivalent qualification covering manicure, nail structure and safe salon practice. Prior gel polish experience strongly recommended. Not open to anyone with a known acrylate or methacrylate sensitivity.
outcomes: Explain the purpose, benefits, limitations and client suitability of builder gel, and compare it with gel polish, hard gel and liquid-and-powder acrylic.
Identify the structures of the nail unit and recognise conditions that require the service to be adapted, postponed or refused.
Conduct and record a professional consultation, obtain informed consent and create an individual treatment plan.
Explain oligomers, monomers, photoinitiators, polymerisation, lamp compatibility, under-curing and the inhibition layer.
Explain why builder gel carries a heat-spike risk that gel polish does not, and control it.
Select, handle, store and dispose of products and equipment in accordance with risk assessment, COSHH, manufacturer instructions and current UK requirements.
Prepare the natural nail without avoidable damage to the plate or living tissue.
Apply a slip layer and build a balanced overlay with a correctly placed apex, straight sidewalls and an even C-curve.
Create a short extension on a tip or form within the product's stated capability.
Infill, rebalance and remove builder gel safely by the method the product requires, and provide appropriate aftercare.
courses.assessment: A written theory paper (50 marks, pass 80%), a directly observed practical on a suitable adult model (80% overall and every safety-critical criterion met) and three post-course case studies. The certificate is issued only when all three are satisfactory; attendance alone is not sufficient.

lessons.title: Welcome, scope and how the course works
What builder gel is, and when another system is the honest answer
Nail anatomy and the conditions that mean adapt, postpone or refer
How gel cures, under-curing, allergy and the heat spike
Apex, stress area, C-curve: the structure that makes a nail last
Health, safety, hygiene and UK legislation
Before the taught day: your pre-course tasks
